C0699.title: No-Inventory Store Model Found Liable for Trademark Infringement
C0699.summary: In 2023, defendant Zhang opened an online store and sold products bearing a mark similar to the plaintiff's registered trademark without authorization, using the trademark in product titles and detail pages. Zhang claimed to have paid only 3,000 yuan to open the store through a friend's introduction, with a third party handling drop-shipping and no physical contact with the goods. The court found
